issue.title: Artifact tranche-zero defects and generic document-sidecar roles
issue.description: Copy mode and marks work on every Artifacts sub-tab, artifact-file path copies are unambiguous, the text-artifact fallback viewer is safe without `bat`, and no SASE code names the `research` sidecar: every user-defined document sidecar gets the behavior `research` has today.

issue.title: Copy mode on every Artifacts sub-tab
issue.description: copy-mode: admit `copy_tab_content` on non-PR Artifacts sub-tabs, dispatch the second copy key on the active sub-tab before falling through to the tab id, add per-sub-tab copy key blocks and real copy menus for Commits, Plans, Chats, and Bugs, and make the COPY footer and its restore path sub-tab aware.

issue.title: Marks on non-PR Artifacts sub-tabs
issue.description: subtab-marks: route `toggle_mark`/`clear_marks` on the Artifacts tab through the active sub-tab instead of the PR list, store marks per sub-tab keyed on the pane's existing stable entry target, render the mark glyph, and let the sub-tab copy menus copy a marked set.

issue.title: Anchored artifact-file path copy
issue.description: path-copy: stop emitting bare workspace-relative paths from the artifact-file modal's path copy, prefer the always-present stored path, anchor any source-path answer, and say in the toast which of the two was copied.

issue.title: Safe text-artifact fallback viewer
issue.description: text-fallback: replace the bare `cat` fallback in the artifact text viewer with a bounded, binary-detecting, control-sequence-neutralizing reader and give the `bat` branch's argument-boundary hygiene to the fallback too.

issue.title: Generic sidecar roles in the SDD store
issue.description: store-roles: replace the store record's fixed plans/research/beads fields with a role-keyed sidecar map, make `SddStore` resolve roots for any configured role, and stop requiring a sidecar literally named `research` before a sidecar-storage record can be written or considered materialized.

issue.title: Route hardcoded role tuples through the role registry
issue.description: role-consumers: replace every remaining literal `("plans", "research", "beads")` tuple and `research`-named branch across repo inventory, linked-repo paths, `sase repo path`, doctor, commit finalization, SDD path helpers, agent env, and the ACE file panel with the generic role registry, and document the role model.

issue.title: Rust core document corpora for plan discovery
issue.description: core-corpora: teach the Rust plan reader to scan caller-supplied `(root, kind)` document corpora instead of only its hardcoded `plans`/`research` sub-directory pair, and expose that through `search_plans` and the PyO3 `plan_search` binding without changing default behavior.

issue.title: Plan search and CLI over document-sidecar roles
issue.description: plan-search-roles: make the Python plan-search facade discover every configured document-sidecar root and pass them to the core as labeled corpora, and make `sase plan search --kind` and its result styling accept any discovered role rather than a fixed four-value choice list.

issue.title: ACE Plans pane over every document sidecar
issue.description: ace-documents: browse and search documents from every configured document sidecar in the Artifacts Plans pane instead of only the plans sidecar, add a kind facet to its filter bar, show each row's kind, and update the ACE docs and help popup.
